basic_profile.bio: I'm a software engineer based in Austin, Texas, with a penchant for digital history and niche music genres. I'm passionate about preserving older software environments, which is why I often experiment with virtual machines. My interests include Islamic history, the dark and mystical narratives of Hellblazer comics, and the insightful discussions from the now-defunct Hello Internet podcast. Typically, you'll find me online in the evenings and late nights, as I juggle my 9-to-5 developing blockchain solutions. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive into my many hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas. My expertise extends to virtualization technologies and blockchain, largely self-taught through online resources and community forums. I've also picked up a fair amount of historical knowledge through personal study and digital archives.
